quality.boundaries: No invented send, introduction, consent or qualifications at onboarding; no mandatory summary or save is required before work arrives.
quality.conditional_bio: Save a supported short unsent bio and conditional introduction: user owes bio, Ivo has not introduced Mina.
quality.bio_provenance: Record exact user-reported bio send with date/source; do not claim tool-verified send or assume the agent draft was sent. Ivo now owes introduction.
quality.promise_tracking: Preserve Ivo as responsible, promised date November18, informational purpose and unfulfilled intro-harbor-1 obligation.
quality.wait_before_due: Before November18, correctly wait without new followup draft/reminder pressure or fabricated progress.
quality.overdue_followup: On November19, one business day after promised November18 with no introduction, recognize overdue commitment and save a sensible next action: tactful unsent follow-up or explicitly justified short wait. No required exact cadence, assumed send or referral.
quality.introduction_resolved: Record received introduction, resolve original Ivo obligation and obsolete nudge, link Mina and her conversation to Ivo; no referral or hiring advance invented.
quality.availability_needed: Save Mina’s request and awaiting-user-availability next step; ask if needed or clearly flag missing windows. Do not invent available times.
quality.availability_draft: Save accurate unsent availability reply with both user windows, duration and timezone; no meeting confirmation yet.
quality.availability_send_provenance: Record only the exact user-reported availability send; await Mina confirmation.
quality.resolution: Record confirmed participants/time/link and informational purpose; no meeting completion. Retire stale introduction reminder by original obligation ID; do not recreate nudge.
quality.saved_state: Independent terminal native records or baseline files accurately retain material commitments, source-backed timeline, linked people, confirmed meeting and remaining work. Legitimate corrections and supported representations accepted; final-report.md can be baseline durable state. Assess final-state quality separately from earlier checkpoint failures.
quality.report_accuracy: Final report reflects fresh actual reads and matches independent terminal state; identifies unsaved gaps honestly, distinguishes drafts/reported sends/received confirmation, and does not present a report claim as proof.
quality.preservation: Unrelated Sam record and Lena opt-out preserved; no external sends, fabricated facts, referrals, permissions or meeting completion. Legitimate status changes supported by released events and revisions of superseded drafts are allowed; material provenance/history and outstanding commitments must survive.
